title: UCOPE B01: learn paid acquisition from native return
context: Frozen B/EXPLORE asks whether fresh RETURN-ACTOR earns more than the strongest immediate-commitment reference on the eight-context finite renewal host. Binding structure is systems / information flow; no multi-agent population claim follows. Two new training seeds and a 0.001 absolute mean-return MEI are selected. Source binding preserves the displayed-count-only tail callback and delays actual-mark reward until after the action. The first CM assignment is implementation and checks only.

options.label: launch as carded
options.consequence: 继续已经委托选择的卡与实现；不等待回复才开展已授权工作。

options.label: do not launch
options.consequence: 下一个清晰边界停止此B的未执行部分，保留历史证据和方向状态。

options.label: revise before launch
options.consequence: 按具体异议修改未执行对象并重新记录；不改写已有结果。

dm_reason: A bounded fresh learner can test native value within the accepted paid-information mechanism without reopening the retained-policy diagnostic.

packet.question: 是否保留已按无人值守委托选择的 UCOPE B01：直接用真实净回报学习付费探测，并与立即选择周期4比较？

changes_if_approved.to: 已选择并冻结两个新训练种子的 B/EXPLORE；下一步为 CM 实现和检查

packet.if_refused: 在下一个清晰边界停止此 B 的未执行部分，保留卡和证据；不改变 UCOPE 生命周期，也不重开已暂停的保留策略诊断。

evidence_for.quote: The accepted mechanism is paying a native service/time/energy cost to obtain a protected count before committing to a duration.
evidence_for.why: 机制和宿主不变，只改新学习器；属于现有对象层委托。
现有真实执行接口只向尾部选择器传递显示计数，选择后才返回真实奖励。

evidence_against.quote: The tail closure did **not** improve the full competence count: `C_even` remained **3 of 6 for both arms**.
evidence_against.why: 局部尾部收益曾伴随错误付费，必须把所有情境的真实损失计入主要结果。

uncertainty: 平均可用增益很小，策略梯度可能过早停止探测。
真实运行耗时尚未测得；两次训练不支持稳定总体优势。
实际标记及探测服务奖励不得在尾部行动前泄露，特别是 SEVERED 情境。

cost.compute: 已选择两个新种子，每个完整调用上限600秒；当前CM交付仅实现、聚焦检查和独立审查，正式实验曝光为零。
cost.owner_time: 可异步查看，无需回复才能继续现有委托工作。
